query:
When the Christmas lights vote came up, what was the group's overall decision and which group member's vote differed most clearly from the majority position, and what did their response signal about their actual preference?

Options:
A. Claire
B. Sandra
C. Dev
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Sandra, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T11:58:00) Just a quick note: yes, and I have already voted for the understated option. I think a uniform single-colour LED display shows more taste than a free-for-all. Not everyone agrees with me on this, I know. -- Sandra
[2] (about=Yuki, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:11:00) Sandra can I say understated? I think I agree with Sandra on this one, some streets just do too much 😬
[3] (about=Claire, core, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Voted for mixed Christmas lights; thinks some colour is fine.
[4] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2025-11-30T12:09:00) didn't vote. don't mind either way
[5] (about=Sandra, core, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Voted for understated single-colour LED Christmas lights; thinks it shows more taste.
[6] (about=Sandra, core, t10 @2025-11-23T10:36:00) In favour of weekly walks; can manage most Sundays except the first week of December due to garden centre Christmas run.
[7] (about=Yuki, core, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Prefers understated Christmas lights; agrees with Sandra.
[8] (about=Yuki, said_by=Sandra, profile, t12 @2025-11-30T11:25:00) Sandra says Yuki has very good taste (regarding Christmas lights preference).
agent_answer:
The group’s overall decision was for **understated single-colour LED Christmas lights** — Sandra voted for this, and Yuki agreed with Sandra.

The member whose vote differed most clearly from the majority was **A. Claire**: she voted for **mixed Christmas lights** and thinks “some colour is fine,” signaling that her actual preference was for the more colourful/mixed option rather than the understated one.

Dev did not vote and didn’t mind either way; Marcus and Ryan have no recorded position in this matter.
